concept: Reentrancy: state updated after an external call lets a callback repeat execution
scene: Technical card on a deep navy background. A simple flow diagram shows a withdraw function sending Ether to a recipient contract, with an amber arrow looping back into the function before the balance box is cleared. A white label marks the unchanged balance. A small badge in the corner reads high severity.
overlay_text: clear the stored balance before calling the recipient
alt_text: Diagram of a withdraw function sending Ether to a contract whose callback loops back into the function while the balance is still unchanged, with the text: clear the stored balance before calling the recipient.
